sentences.text: In Mainz-Bingen there are 580 reports over ten years, with main time May to September.
It belongs to the group Insect or spider, class Insecta, order Lepidoptera.
It has been recorded eating Bird's-foot Trefoil, Oregano, Black Medick and Red Clover.
Recorded as predators are Goldenrod Crab Spider and Flower Spider.
It has been recorded pollinating Bloodwort.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Bird's-foot Trefoil, White Clover, Tansy and Alfalfa.
